label: China AI regulation · Comprehensive AI Law adopted (2027)
prompt:
Will the NPC or its Standing Committee adopt a comprehensive Artificial Intelligence Law by 31 December 2027?

Resolving yes rebinds the China model to params/ai-law.json.
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES on NPC/NPCSC adoption of a law titled as a general AI law (人工智能法). Amendments to existing laws (e.g. the Cybersecurity Law) or CAC measures do not count.

diagnostics.label: Legislative plan
diagnostics.note: Listed on State Council legislative work plans since 2023 without a draft reaching first reading.

diagnostics.label: Piecemeal path
diagnostics.note: Beijing has preferred targeted measures plus the 2026 CSL amendment; a general law may stay deferred.
